task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into OpenClinica and navigates to the Study Event Definitions section for DM-TRIAL-2024.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the OpenClinica dashboard, the study 'DM-TRIAL-2024' selected, and the 'Build Study' or 'Tasks' menu leading to 'Define Study Events'.

task_completion.description: Rename 'Baseline Assessment' to 'Screening and Baseline Visit' and update its description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or table view showing the event name changed to 'Screening and Baseline Visit' and the description field containing 'Screening procedures followed by baseline clinical and laboratory assessments per Amendment 03'.

task_completion.description: Set the 'Week 4 Follow-up' event to be a repeating visit.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Repeating' checkbox or radio button set to 'Yes' (or checked) for the 'Week 4 Follow-up' event definition.

task_completion.description: Update the category for 'Week 4 Follow-up' to 'Treatment Window'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Category' dropdown or text field for 'Week 4 Follow-up' showing 'Treatment Window'.

task_completion.description: Update the category for 'End of Treatment' to 'Study Completion'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Category' dropdown or text field for 'End of Treatment' showing 'Study Completion'.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the changes and the system confirms the updates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Submit' or 'Save' button being clicked, followed by a success message (e.g., 'The study event has been updated successfully') or an updated list view reflecting all changes.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenClinica web interface rather than direct database manipulation or terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the browser interacting with the OpenClinica UI elements (buttons, text fields, dropdowns).

integrity.description: The 'Adverse Event Report' event remains unchanged.
integrity.visual_evidence: The list of study events shows 'Adverse Event Report' with its original settings, or the agent avoids clicking the edit icon for this specific event.

integrity.description: The agent is logged in as 'root' and working within the 'DM-TRIAL-2024' study environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The header of the OpenClinica page shows the username 'root' and the active study name 'DM-TRIAL-2024'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The study identifier is 'DM-TRIAL-2024'. The 'Baseline Assessment' must be renamed to 'Screening and Baseline Visit' with a description mentioning 'Amendment 03'. The 'Week 4 Follow-up' must have 'Repeating' set to true/yes and Category set to 'Treatment Window'. The 'End of Treatment' Category must be 'Study Completion'. The 'Adverse Event Report' must not be modified.
